content.narration: You are in Jupiter Mahadasha (ends 1991-08-18, age ~7) -> Saturn Antardasha (ends 1980-04-18, age ~-4) -> Jupiter Pratyantardasha (current, ends 1980-04-18, age ~-4). Saturn, your Antardasha lord, is exalted in your 7 house (Vishakha). Jupiter, your Pratyantardasha lord, is own in your 9 house (Mula).

note: The queried date (1980-01-01) is ~4 years before the native's birth (1984-02-05). The tool does NOT reject the query or return empty -- it silently computes and serves dasha rows as if valid, including a two_pass_verified citation tier. The only signal that this is a pre-birth query is the narration string's own arithmetic artifact 'age ~-4' -- there is no explicit birth_date-vs-as_of_date guard, no warning field, no judgment_flag. A caller (or LLM synthesizing on top of this tool) that does not parse the free-text narration for a negative age could easily present 'Jupiter Mahadasha / Saturn Antardasha, Saturn exalted in 7th' as the native's real psychological/karmic state in 1980 -- which is meaningless since the native did not exist. This is mathematically well-defined (Vimshottari balance-of-dasha-at-birth extrapolates backward as pure arithmetic) but the tool does not disclose the pre-birth condition as a structured, machine-checkable flag.
